memory_update.text: KRT is the highest-purity underfollowed public candidate for restaurant off-premise packaging and should advance to Layer 2 evidence checks.
GPK has explicit QSR/foodservice cups, lids, and food-container exposure, but restaurant exposure must be quantified because the company is a broader paperboard packaging business.
AMCR is a large-cap reference anchor after acquiring Berry Global; it should not dominate the underfollowed lane unless legacy Berry foodservice assets prove unusually material.
SON remains a speculative shadow candidate until material QSR/restaurant packaging revenue is verified.

Several highly relevant foodservice packaging assets are private or no longer public: Dart Container, Novolex/Pactiv, Sabert, D&W Fine Pack, and National DCP-style foodservice procurement/distribution networks. This limits pure-play public access and increases the importance of KRT and GPK verification.

Regulation-driven shifts away from foam/plastic and toward recyclable, compostable, or fiber-based formats may be a more durable chokepoint than simple takeout volume growth; future layers should test which public companies have compliant SKUs and capacity.

node: Off-premise packaging, disposables, and delivery-enabling consumables
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-market universe for restaurant off-premise packaging. The clearest underfollowed public candidate is Karat Packaging, a small-cap focused on disposable foodservice products for restaurant chains and foodservice settings. Graphic Packaging is a mid-cap reference-to-underfollowed hybrid with explicit QSR exposure in cups, lids, and food containers. Amcor is now the public reference anchor after acquiring Berry Global, which had direct QSR, coffee-shop, and foodservice packaging exposure, but Amcor is less pure and larger-cap. Sonoco is included as a lower-confidence underfollowed hypothesis because it has foodservice/QSR-adjacent smallware, trays, and fiber packaging capabilities, but restaurant off-premise exposure appears less direct and needs segment/customer verification. Important private anchors such as Dart Container, Novolex/Pactiv, Sabert, and D&W Fine Pack suggest the node is strategically real but not fully accessible through public equities.
